scope: Fresh pinned offline GCC-native strict ASAN/UBSAN(no recovery) actual joined-cursor/mapped-prefix model and exact copied D mapped allocator model. Concurrent exact slot ownership, post-unmap readonly ranges, block/uint32 extremes and allocator lifetime/release. Synthetic final-state stores separately described by model. Native TSAN does not claim x86 TSAN. No old end-reuse/allocator proof relabeled.

commands.script:
set -eu
export ASAN_OPTIONS=halt_on_error=1
export UBSAN_OPTIONS=halt_on_error=1:print_stacktrace=1
g++ -std=c++20 -O1 -g -march=native -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror -pthread -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -fno-omit-frame-pointer /repo/.build/round334/joined_cursor_model.cpp -o /out/joined_cursor
sha256sum /out/joined_cursor >/out/joined_cursor.sha256.tmp
mv /out/joined_cursor.sha256.tmp /out/joined_cursor.sha256
/out/joined_cursor >/out/joined_cursor.stdout 2>/out/joined_cursor.stderr
echo 0 >/out/joined_cursor.passed
g++ -std=c++20 -O1 -g -march=native -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror -pthread -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -fno-omit-frame-pointer '-DMAPPED_ALLOCATOR_HEADER="/repo/.build/round334/source/track-d/mapped_allocator.hpp"' /repo/tools/test_mapped_allocator.cpp -o /out/mapped_allocator
sha256sum /out/mapped_allocator >/out/mapped_allocator.sha256.tmp
mv /out/mapped_allocator.sha256.tmp /out/mapped_allocator.sha256
/out/mapped_allocator >/out/mapped_allocator.stdout 2>/out/mapped_allocator.stderr
echo 0 >/out/mapped_allocator.passed

models.name: joined_cursor
models.stdout: PASS joined cursor model 4775652 checks; actual atomic claims/unique coverage/post-unmap readonly ranges, narrow/wide block seams, forced-wide dispatch,0/65535/65536/uint32 extremes; synthetic final-state stores are separate from literal claim coverage

models.name: mapped_allocator
models.stdout: PASS mapped vector growth, alignment, overflow, direct OS release and cross-thread destruction
